name: D'Vorah escapes Outworld with Shinnok's amulet for Quan Chi
description: After stealing Shinnok's amulet, D'Vorah escapes Outworld carrying it for Quan Chi as instructed. This occurrence stops at her departure with the amulet; Cassie's squad discovering the betrayal, Kotal's mistaken inference about Earthrealm, and D'Vorah's later arrival at Quan Chi remain separate later slices.
